description: One reviewer's returned classifications. Committed verbatim; wording is never edited.

reviewer_fields.reviewer: name as the reviewer gives it
reviewer_fields.affiliation: used only to check independence against another reviewer of the same card
reviewer_fields.coauthors_with: list of names, so a shared-coauthorship conflict is checkable, not assumed
reviewer_fields.declined: true if the reviewer declined; classifications may then be empty
reviewer_fields.meta_verdict: optional. e.g. 'per-operator validity is the wrong unit of analysis'. Recorded as itself, never forced into a label.

classification_fields.label: one of: valid | invalid | unclear | scope-dependent
classification_fields.named_semantic: the suite semantic the judgement turns on; required for every label
classification_fields.rationale: the reviewer's own words, minimum 40 characters
classification_fields.disputes_author_applicability: true if they disagree with the card's own applicable flag

refusals: a classification missing named_semantic or rationale
a submission of 3 or more classifications where every label is 'valid' AND the mean rationale length is under 120 characters, which is indistinguishable from a rubber stamp
a card_id not in the frozen manifest
a duplicate card_id from the same reviewer
